field.label: Enable
field.help: Run netflector. The daemon needs at least one enabled reflector below, so the service stays stopped until you add one.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Verbosity of the daemon's log, under Services > Netflector > Log File. Every line is recorded at the same syslog priority, so filter on the level in the message text. "Debug" is noisy and is meant for diagnosing a problem, not for running.

field.label: CARP dependency
field.help: Reflect only while this node holds the selected CARP virtual IP. Leave empty on a single firewall. When synchronizing Netflector to the other HA node, synchronize Virtual IPs as well.

field.label: Counter interval
field.help: Seconds between per-interface packet-counter summaries in the log, up to one day. 0 disables them.
